summary: Loan forgiveness isn't about handouts. It is about growing the economy. Tax relief can be an engine for middle class growth. Just allow total debt to be a write off and allow a "negative" tax rate to spread cost over years.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Loan forgiveness isn't about handouts. It is about growing the economy.

Tax relief can be an engine for middle class growth. Just allow total debt to be a write off and allow a "negative" tax rate to spread cost over years.
